stem: While calculating the legal deadline, a Massachusetts outpatient pharmacy dispenses Sublocade pursuant to a prescription. Which monitoring conclusion is safest?

choices.text: Omit the dispensing because MassPAT receives only Schedule II records.
Treat administration by a health professional as automatically eliminating a pharmacy dispensing report.
Use the product program in place of MassPAT submission.
Report only if the prescription later receives a refill.
Treat covered Schedule III dispensing as MassPAT-reportable under the current dispenser standard.

explanation.core_reasoning: 'Treat covered Schedule III dispensing as MassPAT-reportable under the current dispenser standard.' is the governing result. By contrast, 'Omit the dispensing because MassPAT receives only Schedule II records.' would require that Massachusetts reporting excluded Schedule III dispensing. The decisive cue appears in 'While calculating the legal deadline, a Massachusetts outpatient pharmacy dispenses Sublocade pursuant to a prescription. Which monitoring conclusion is safest?'.

choice_analysis.A: 'Omit the dispensing because MassPAT receives only Schedule II records.' would apply only if Massachusetts reporting excluded Schedule III dispensing; 'While calculating the legal deadline, a Massachusetts outpatient pharmacy dispenses Sublocade pursuant to a prescription. Which monitoring conclusion is safest?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.B: 'Treat administration by a health professional as automatically eliminating a pharmacy dispensing report.' would apply only if the pharmacy's covered dispensing transaction fell outside the reporting standard; 'While calculating the legal deadline, a Massachusetts outpatient pharmacy dispenses Sublocade pursuant to a prescription. Which monitoring conclusion is safest?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.C: 'Use the product program in place of MassPAT submission.' would apply only if a product-specific distribution program displaced state PMP reporting; 'While calculating the legal deadline, a Massachusetts outpatient pharmacy dispenses Sublocade pursuant to a prescription. Which monitoring conclusion is safest?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.D: 'Report only if the prescription later receives a refill.' would apply only if MassPAT reporting were triggered by refill status rather than covered dispensing; 'While calculating the legal deadline, a Massachusetts outpatient pharmacy dispenses Sublocade pursuant to a prescription. Which monitoring conclusion is safest?' states otherwise.
choice_analysis.E: 'Treat covered Schedule III dispensing as MassPAT-reportable under the current dispenser standard.': supported by dispensing-data submission.

related_facts: buprenorphine extended-release injection (Sublocade) is used for treatment of moderate to severe opioid use disorder after transmucosal initiation; it is federal Schedule III and Massachusetts Schedule III.

Covered pharmacies report dispensing of Schedule II through V controlled substances and DPH-designated additional drugs, including gabapentin, to the Massachusetts PMP under the current submission standard.
